title: Assets
description: Equipment, fleet, maintenance, and operational stock.

assets.title: No assets yet
assets.body: Track equipment and vehicles, then log maintenance as operational notes.

fleet.title: No fleet vehicles yet
fleet.body: Link plate, VIN and odometer to vehicle assets.

maintenance.title: No maintenance records yet
maintenance.body: Log planned and completed service on asset detail pages. Overdue and upcoming lists appear here.

inventory.title: No inventory items yet
inventory.body: Track on-hand operational quantity. Receive and issue change quantity only - not cost, not Actual, and not FIFO/AVG costing.

createAsset.title: New asset
createAsset.description: Add equipment or a vehicle. Fleet details are optional.

fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.description: Plate, VIN, and odometer for linked vehicles.
fleet.schemaLimitsBody: Ownership, lease, and driver tracking are not available yet. Project assignment uses the linked asset. Mileage is odometer only.
fleet.schemaLimitsDetails: Ownership/rental, lease, and driver/employee fields are not available yet. Project check-out uses the asset’s assigned project.

schedule.title: Maintenance schedule
schedule.emptyUpcoming: No upcoming maintenance in the next 30 days.
schedule.hint: Derived from planned/in-progress status and performed-on date. No notifications are sent.

detail.assignmentHint: Assign to a project to check out; clear to check in.
detail.historyHint: Chronological maintenance records for this asset.
detail.maintenanceHint: Cost here is operational metadata only and does not create an expense.
detail.costNotExpense: Not an Expense - cost is metadata only. No expense posting or ledger link.
detail.createLinkedExpenseHint: To affect Actual, explicitly create a linked expense draft - then finalize it in Expenses.

inventory.title: Operational quantity
inventory.description: On-hand operational quantity only. Movements change quantity - not cost, not Actual, not GL. No FIFO or average costing.
inventory.detailDescription: Operational quantity only. Recording a movement does not create cost, Actual, expense, or a ledger entry. No FIFO/AVG inventory costing.
inventory.qtyOnlyBanner: Quantity-only inventory - not Actual cost / not FIFO
inventory.qtyOnlyBannerHe: מלאי כמות בלבד - לא עלות בספרים / לא FIFO
inventory.qtyOnlyBannerEn: Quantity-only inventory - not bookkeeping cost / not FIFO
inventory.threeActionsHint: Purchase receiving, inventory quantity, and material usage are three different actions. None of them posts project Actual.
inventory.locationsHint: Quantity-only bins. Receive goes to a location, issue comes from one, transfer moves between two. Header on-hand is the sum.
inventory.locationsEmpty: No locations yet. The default Main / ראשי location is created on first receive.
inventory.movementNotExpense: Stock movements change on-hand operational quantity only. They are not cost, not Actual, not expenses, and do not post to the ledger. No FIFO or average costing.
inventory.adjustQuantityHint: For adjustments, enter a signed delta (for example 2 or -1).
inventory.historyHint: Chronological quantity movements for this item. Operational quantity only - no cost, Actual, FIFO, or average costing.
inventory.reservationsHint: Available = on hand minus active reservations. Reserving does not change on-hand quantity and is not Actual.
inventory.countsHint: Draft lines, then finalize. Finalize creates quantity adjust movements only - not Actual, not GL, not Expense.
inventory.countNotActual: Finalizing a count only posts adjust movements. It never creates Actual cost.

errors.insufficientQuantity: Not enough quantity on hand for this issue.
errors.insufficientAvailable: Not enough available quantity. Release or consume a reservation first.
errors.reservationTargetRequired: Reserve for a project and/or work order.
errors.countNotDraft: Only a draft count can be changed or finalized.
errors.countHasNoLines: Add at least one counted line before finalizing.
errors.notAWorkOrder: That record is not a work order.
errors.locationNameTaken: A location with this name already exists.
errors.cannotArchiveLocationWithStock: Transfer or issue remaining quantity before archiving this location.
errors.transferLocationsRequired: Transfer requires a from location and a to location.
errors.transferSameLocation: Transfer from and to locations must be different.
errors.locationRequired: Choose a location for this movement.
errors.invalidMaintenanceTransition: That maintenance status change is not allowed.
errors.fleetRequiresVehicle: Fleet records must link to a vehicle asset.
errors.fleetAlreadyLinked: This vehicle already has a fleet record.
errors.fleetKindLocked: Remove the fleet record before changing this asset away from vehicle.
errors.invalidUsageDateRange: Usage end date must be on or after the start date.

usage.panelNote: Usage attributes materials and equipment to this work as operational quantity. It never creates Actual cost - purchase Actual stays on expenses / vendor bills once. No FIFO/AVG.
usage.threeActionsHint: Purchase receiving, inventory quantity, and material usage are three different actions. None of them posts project Actual.
usage.notActualHint: Operational quantity only - does not create Actual, Expense, or ledger entries. Not inventory costing (no FIFO or average). Purchase cost is recognized once when you buy.
usage.stockSeparateHint: Usage does not change on-hand quantity. Use inventory receive/issue to update operational stock. Low stock is an operational reorder indicator only - not cost.
usage.materialHint: Log operational qty used on this project, job, or work order. Optional catalog / inventory links. Quantity only - not cost or Actual.
usage.equipmentHint: Log asset use by date or range, with optional hours, days, or mileage.
usage.needProject: Create a project or job before recording usage from inventory.

emptyMaterial.title: No material usage yet
emptyMaterial.body: Record operational quantity used here. It does not post cost or Actual.

emptyEquipment.title: No equipment usage yet
emptyEquipment.body: Log asset time or mileage here. Assignment is not Actual.

financeLink.hint: Creates an Expense draft only. Actual changes after you finalize the expense - not from this operational record alone.
financeLink.allocationHint: When set, uses the existing overhead allocation engine (contract weight / annual). Still draft until finalized.

errors.alreadyLinked: This record already has a linked expense.
errors.amountRequired: Amount is required to create a linked expense.
errors.currencyRequired: Currency is required to create a linked expense.
errors.inventoryNotExpense: Inventory movements cannot create linked expenses.
errors.unsupportedKind: This operational record type cannot link to expenses.
errors.mustBeDraft: Linked expenses must be created as drafts.
errors.notLinked: Expense is not linked to an operational record.
